Package org.praxisplatform.uischema.id

Class JpaCriteriaPathSupport

java.lang.Object
org.praxisplatform.uischema.id.JpaCriteriaPathSupport
public final class JpaCriteriaPathSupport extends Object
Shared JPA Criteria path navigation and composite-key predicate/order support for GenericSpecificationsBuilder, JpaOptionSourceQueryExecutor, JpaStatsQueryExecutor, and AbstractBaseQueryResourceService.
